text:
Predicates:
ContainsKnowledge(x) ::: x contains knowledge.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x becomes smarter.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is authored by z.
Premises:
Books contain tons of knowledge.
Reads(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden”.
Reads(x, y) → GainsKnowledge(x) ::: If a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Author(walden, henryThoreau) ::: Walden is authored by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
ContainsKnowledge(walden) ::: Walden contains knowledge.
